tasks.short: Direct and coordinate the surgical care team

steps.what: Review current care needs and staff availability
Determine activities and responsibilities for nurses, assistants and specialists
Write assignments into the existing team care plan
Communicate assignments and confirm colleagues understand their responsibilities
Direct ongoing activities and resolve changes in the child's condition

tasks.design: Use the native care-team view and an existing care-plan template in {OTHER}, the clinical record system. The surgeon decides assignments, writes them separately, communicates them and directs the ongoing care.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated navigation and stable plan headings consume a small share of coordination time.
tasks.enabler_now: Native views and templates can remove these operations without allocating clinical work autonomously.
tasks.still_hard: Changing acuity, competence and interruptions require clinical leadership.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise when an assignment no longer fits the child's needs.
tasks.altitude: Reduce repeated navigation while retaining direct clinical coordination.

reach.learn: Confirm ownership and escalate changing care needs

evidence.claim: Native care-team views and care-plan templates can remove navigation and repeated headings; local effects remain E1.

assumptions: The team already uses the stated care plan to follow assignments. This is not a newly added staffing log; if coordination is purely verbal, there is no s3 saving.

The surgeon reviews current care and availability in s1 and produces patient, activity, responsible colleague and timing fields in s2-s3; capture is counted. Missing availability requires direct confirmation.
A native view removes 1 lookup hour; plan headings remove 2 of 10 entry hours. Clinical assignment decisions and colleague discussion remain unchanged.
Ordinary author saves need no approval. No additional recurring upkeep is assumed for stable native views and headings.
unknowns: Whether the surgeon writes the assumed team care plan today
research_questions: Which repeated fields does the surgeon currently enter during team coordination?

already_counted.description: Capture the actual assignment and confirm it with colleagues

incremental.description: No separate recurring administration for fixed native views and headings

approvals.approved_version: Exact patient, assigned activity, colleague and timing communicated; changed care needs require reconsideration

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 central B=100, R=97, zero upkeep gives 3 net. Conservative case: the view is already used and current care-plan headings are already present, retaining all 100 hours. Where the view removes 0.5 lookup hour and the existing template removes 1.5 entry hours, 98 hours remain and 2 net is possible. No team member's labour is transferred or counted as surgeon saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Examine children and determine the need for intervention

steps.what: Review the child's clinical record and relevant investigation results
Examine fetuses, infants, children or adolescents as clinically appropriate
Diagnose health issues and determine whether intervention is needed
Write and verify examination findings and the clinical assessment

loop.purpose: Draft the examination note from the surgeon's own dictated findings and assessment
loop.input: Surgeon's patient-specific dictation with encounter identification
loop.output: Draft note separating findings, assessment and plan
loop.check: Surgeon verifies every finding, negation, identity and intervention statement before retaining the note
loop.stop: One correction; missing or uncertain content is entered manually
loop.why_not_simpler: Clinical dictation varies beyond fixed fields; the model does not diagnose

tasks.design: Use a native patient-results view in {OTHER}, the clinical record system, then retain examination and diagnosis with the surgeon. A bounded drafting loop assists the existing note from explicit surgeon dictation; the surgeon corrects and retains it in the same record.
tasks.previous_blocker: Reviewing dispersed results and writing the examination note consume time around direct assessment.
tasks.enabler_now: Clinical scribe products demonstrate clinician-validated note drafting; suitability for pediatric examination still needs local testing.
tasks.still_hard: Subtle physical findings, uncertain presentations and intervention decisions remain clinical judgement.
tasks.human_edge: Integrate examination and context to decide what the child needs.
tasks.altitude: Assist the record while preserving direct examination and diagnosis.

reach.task: Use the recorded assessment for ongoing care
reach.learn: Distinguish observed findings from clinical interpretation

evidence.claim: Autoscriber describes clinician validation of drafted clinical notes and clinical-record integration.
A European scribe study reported self-estimated note-time reductions, but this does not measure pediatric examination savings.

assumptions: The existing examination note is included and split from direct examination. Family explanation is handled separately in 22769 and not counted here.

The surgeon produces patient identity, encounter, findings, negations, diagnosis and intervention rationale in s2-s4; dictation and checking remain inside the retained 15 note hours. No findings are inferred from absent dictation.
The native results view removes 1.5 of 15 navigation hours, retaining interpretation. If source data are missing or identifiers conflict, the surgeon retrieves them manually.
This design edits and saves the author's note in the same clinical system. No separate machine write-back, external send, approval stage or save-time benefit is claimed.
unknowns: Pediatric terminology and negation error rate
Whether existing dictation already eliminates the proposed drafting work
research_questions: Does the tool reduce actual note work after dictation, correction and ongoing quality review?

already_counted.description: Dictate, correct and verify the examination and assessment note

incremental.description: Review changed drafting behaviour and sample notes for omissions

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 central B=100, R=93.5, gross 6.5 less 3 upkeep gives 3.5 net. Conservative case: the view is already efficient and terminology corrections retain 18 note hours, with other 80 plus 2 upkeep giving zero. A usable view retaining 14 record-review hours and carefully checked drafting retaining 17 note hours, plus 65 direct clinical hours and 2 upkeep, gives 2 net. Scribe study percentages are not applied to the full clinical encounter.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Follow surgical techniques during the operation

steps.what: Assess operative findings and the suitability of the established technique
Choose the next surgical manoeuvre for the observed anatomy
Follow established surgical techniques while performing the selected manoeuvre
Check the operative effect and adapt the technique when conditions change

tasks.design: Retain observation, technique selection, physical execution and assessment with the pediatric surgeon. No document or workflow tool substitutes for these operative actions.
tasks.previous_blocker: The work depends on direct perception, dexterity and clinical judgement.
tasks.enabler_now: No supported software change removes a named operative step.
tasks.still_hard: Anatomy and physiological conditions can change during the manoeuvre.
tasks.human_edge: Respond appropriately to the actual operative field.

reach.learn: Anticipate operative needs while escalating unexpected conditions

evidence.claim: The task's physical operative work cannot be replaced by record templates or note drafting.

assumptions: This task names the technique during the operation. It does not name a report or plan write; no trailing record is invented. Existing examination documentation is priced in 22765, and this file does not claim that record labour as operative time.
Inputs are the surgeon's direct operative observations, produced in s1 and reassessed in s4 with their time retained; there is no hidden structured-data contract.
Native views, templates and settings touch none of the listed physical manoeuvres. No instrument runtime or robotic capability is assumed to remove surgeon labour.
No new software or administration is introduced, so recurring incremental work is zero.
research_questions: Does direct observation confirm that this task boundary contains only the stated operative actions?

already_counted.description: Observe and assess operative conditions and effects

incremental.description: No new workflow or software work

approvals.approved_version: The exact manoeuvre on the identified patient and observed operative site; changed anatomy or conditions require a new clinical decision

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 B=100 and R=100, zero new upkeep. Observation, selection, execution and assessment are all retained in both conservative and favourable cases; no eligible administrative work is named inside the operative technique task.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Inform parents and guardians about health problems and surgery

steps.what: Review the child's current assessment and select appropriate explanatory material
Inform parents or guardians and check their understanding
Write the explanation and outstanding family questions in the clinical record
Prepare the existing written information supplied after the discussion
Send the checked information packet to the verified parent or guardian

tasks.design: Use a native results view in {OTHER}, the clinical record and patient portal system, and approved material in {DOCS}. The surgeon retains the family discussion, separately writes its clinical note, prepares the existing follow-up packet and checks its exact version and recipient before sending.
tasks.previous_blocker: Finding current material and repeating stable note and packet structure takes time around family communication.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing document libraries and native templates can reuse those specific elements without generating patient-specific advice.
tasks.still_hard: Understanding, distress, guardianship and uncertain outcomes require personal attention.
tasks.human_edge: Respond to the family's concerns and check what they understood.
tasks.altitude: Support clear family communication with less repeated document handling.

reach.learn: Recognise unresolved questions rather than infer consent

evidence.claim: Thuisarts provides guideline-based patient information; local pediatric surgical material must still be checked for applicability.
The proposed native template labour reductions are unmeasured.

assumptions: This portfolio already includes a clinical discussion note and written follow-up information read by the family. Neither is added to create a saving. Cases with only oral explanation have no packet baseline.

The surgeon produces clinical context in s1, discussion facts in s2-s3 and verifies recipient identity and authority in s5; capture and verification are counted. Uncertain recipients or unsuitable material are handled manually without sending.

The view removes 1.5 lookup hours; stable discussion headings remove 2.25 note hours; reusing approved packet sections removes 1 assembly hour. Patient-specific writing and every send remain retained.
The author saves the discussion note in the same record without self-approval. No ambient recording, new patient data feed or automatic patient advice is assumed.
unknowns: Actual share of discussions with written follow-up
Whether the existing note and packet already use templates
research_questions: Are the proposed repeated headings and packet sections actually written manually today?

already_counted.description: Capture the discussion and check the exact follow-up packet before sending

incremental.description: Check reusable information sections when local guidance changes

approvals.approved_version: Exact explanation and advice voiced to the verified parent or guardian, reconsidered as new questions or findings emerge
Exact final information packet, clinical applicability and verified recipient; any content or recipient change voids the send decision

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 central B=100, R=95.25, gross 4.75 less 1 upkeep gives 3.75 net. Conservative case: record navigation and headings are already optimised and family-specific packet revisions remove only one hour, offset by one upkeep hour, giving zero. With current metadata removing 0.5 lookup hour, reusable headings removing 1.5 note hours and approved sections removing 1 packet hour, 97 hours remain and 1 upkeep gives 2 net. All conversation and send work remains retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Keep clinical judgement, operative skill and family communication personal while reducing repeated documentation.
reach: Coordinate clear responsibilities with the care team
Connect documented assessments with understandable family information
skills_to_grow: Check clinical draft notes for omissions and negation errors
Use native clinical templates without implying unobserved findings
Distinguish record saves from actual clinical handoffs
role.ambitious_version: A pediatric surgeon with clearer documentation and team coordination while retaining direct responsibility for every clinical decision.
